_comment: Epoch AI Frontier Data Centers (spec 007, US4). CC-BY 4.0: credit
'Epoch AI, Frontier Data Centers' wherever the data is used. The
attribution and the sampling limit are recorded in the source manifest
The campus file carries no date, so earliest_date_from attaches the
earliest dated observation for each campus from Epoch's timelines file.
That is the first time Epoch saw the site (often land clearing), a bound
on the announcement and never the announcement itself.
Sampling limit: frontier-scale campuses only (about 90 worldwide). Never
a sample of data centers in general.
